gitCommit.subject: chore(screenshots): npm run screenshots + pr-screenshots skill (codify the UI-PR screenshot step) (#225)
gitCommit.body:
chore(screenshots): npm run screenshots + pr-screenshots skill (codify the UI-PR screenshot step) (#225)

Adds a repeatable capture so UI PRs reliably ship light+dark screenshots:
- e2e/screenshots/capture.ts — light+dark shots of collections grid, items grid,
  item detail on tablet+phone, reusing the e2e harness (throwaway Docker DB,
  baseline auth, the standard /file intercept). Excluded from the CI e2e gate
  (testMatch is *.spec.ts; this is *.ts under a dedicated config).
- playwright.screenshots.config.ts — dedicated config (setup+tablet+phone).
- npm run screenshots — one command -> pr-screenshots/ (gitignored).
- .claude/skills/pr-screenshots/SKILL.md — the workflow (capture -> release ->
  inline embed), pointing at docs/cookbook/add-images-to-pr.md.
- .gitignore — un-ignore the new skill; anchor the PNG-output ignore to root.
